tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description: List all symbols with derivatives data (BTC, ETH, ...).

tools.name: get_funding_rates
tools.description: Current perp funding rate per venue for a symbol, with annualized apr (0.05 = 5%/yr) and cross-venue spread. Venues: binance, bybit, okx, hyperliquid, bitget, gate.

tools.name: get_funding_history
tools.description: Historical funding-rate snapshots (5-min resolution), newest first.

tools.name: get_open_interest
tools.description: Current open interest per venue for a symbol (base units + USD) and the cross-venue USD total.

tools.name: get_funding_spreads
tools.description: Ranked cross-venue funding spread per symbol (max apr minus min apr, decimals). Answers: where does the same perp pay most differently right now?

tools.name: get_liquidations
tools.description: Recent liquidation events (side = position side liquidated), newest first.
